method.note: A recommendation on a 0–100 scale, not a chance of being retained. Weights and bands are provisional: there are no franchise decisions yet to calibrate them against.

performance.rule: Chosen on next-season rank correlation over 2016–2023; 2024–2026 is reported, not used to choose.

aging.note: Runs per match change from one season to the next by age at the second season, relative to the average change at all ages (which is regression to the mean). Shrunk toward zero by n/(n+30).

decisionBacktest.note: Area under the ROC curve for ranking kept players above released ones, on the out-of-time retention decisions. 0.5 is chance.

components.performance: Three seasons, weighted by balls, shrunk toward the league prior by empirical Bayes; a missing season adds nothing rather than counting as zero. Phase, venue and opposition adjusted. Percentile among squad players of the same role.
components.scarcity: Gap to the best unsigned player in the same granular role and nationality (70%), and how many teammates already cover the role (30%).
components.economics: Expected auction price against the contract, as a percentile. Left out when the salary is missing or the price model is outside its training range.
components.fit: Change to the franchise's best XII from the squad optimiser (50%) and whether the player is in that XII (50%). No captaincy bonus.
components.horizon: Age effect on output over the next three seasons, measured on IPL history. Left out where the birth date is not verified.

miCaseStudies.name: JJ Bumrah

Role scarcity: Indian death-overs pacer. Best unsigned in the role: MM Sharma at -0.5, a gap of +5.1 per match; 0 teammates cover it.
Auction economics: Not scored: Rated above nearly every player ever sold: players this good are usually retained, so few sales show what one would fetch.
Tactical XI/XII fit: In the MI best XII; +2.0 runs per match against the next-best squad option
Age and cycle horizon: Age 34 in 2027. Players this age change by +0.3 runs per match next season and +0.2 over three, measured on IPL history
